name: re-verify both hosts eval
command: cd /home/davr/.config/dendritic && echo "--- ASAHI max-jobs/cores ---" && nix eval --impure --json .#nixosConfigurations.ASAHI.config.nix.settings --apply 's: { inherit (s) max-jobs cores; }' 2>&1 | grep -v 'saved setting' | tail -3 && echo "--- ASAHI toplevel drv ---" && nix eval --impure .#nixosConfigurations.ASAHI.config.system.build.toplevel.drvPath 2>&1 | grep -v 'saved setting' | tail -3 && echo "--- NIXPC toplevel drv ---" && nix eval --impure .#nixosConfigurations.NIXPC.config.system.build.toplevel.drvPath 2>&1 | grep -v 'saved setting' | tail -2
